title: Response Board and overview navigation cancel on wheel or touch that does not navigate the transcript
outcome: Delayed Response Board source jumps and conversation-overview seeks currently subscribe to raw wheel/touchstart on the transcript node. A nested code/table scroller consuming wheel, a suppressed wheel event or a touch tap can cancel a pending jump despite no transcript navigation. Reuse the pane's normalized navigation owner, or filter raw input through its existing routing/suppression contract, without introducing another scroll authority. Preserve cancellation after real newer transcript input.
acceptance: Pending Response Board and conversation-overview navigation survives wheel consumed by nested scrollables, suppressed wheel and touch taps that do not navigate the transcript, while genuine newer transcript navigation still cancels delayed history/frame work.
Focused regression tests cover non-navigation controls and genuine navigation in both consumers, and affected UI suites and TypeScript pass.
